products.description: Eight PDFs (journal prompts, worksheets, a 7-day plan, affirmation cards and a sleep checklist) plus two 10-minute binaural-beat audio tracks. One-time $37 digital download, no shipping.
products.long:
## Can't quiet your mind at night?
When the day is over but your thoughts keep going, even bedtime can feel exhausting.

## It's not always about trying harder to relax
Sometimes the hardest part of bedtime is the shift from a busy day to a quiet night. Unfinished tasks, constant notifications and daily pressures can keep your attention busy long after you put your phone down.
Instead of forcing yourself to stop thinking, it may help to build a small, repeatable routine that gives you time to pause, reflect and unwind.

## What could your evenings look like?
- Less mental clutter: make space to organize your thoughts instead of carrying every worry into bed.
- A calmer bedtime routine: build a consistent wind-down ritual that fits your day.
- Simple steps: follow manageable exercises instead of adding another complicated task.
- More time for yourself: a few quiet moments to reflect, breathe and reset.

Individual experiences vary. These are intended benefits, not guaranteed outcomes.
products.html:
Is your mind still busy when the day is over?

Unfinished tasks, notifications and daily pressure can keep your thoughts running long after you put your phone down.

Trying harder to relax doesn’t always work. A small, repeatable routine that gives you time to pause and reflect can be an easier place to start.

A simpler way to approach it

Calm Reset is a printable digital journaling and reflection bundle: eight PDFs and two short audio tracks. Instead of starting from a blank page, you get a worked example, a fillable daily worksheet, 30 daily prompts and a 7-day plan.

How you might use it

  1. Download the zip after you buy and unzip it. Open “Read Me First”, then start with the Reset Practice.
  2. Read the worked example, then write a short reply on the daily worksheet. You can fill it in on screen, print it, or use your own notebook.
  3. Use the 7-day plan and the weekly tracker to see what is worth repeating, or pick one of the 30 daily prompts.
  4. Add the two 10-minute audio tracks if you like. They are optional.

Who it may suit

  • Adults who want a beginner-friendly way into journaling and quiet reflection.
  • People who prefer guided prompts and a clear structure to a blank notebook.
  • Anyone who likes printable worksheets, or who is happy to type into fillable PDFs.

Who it may not suit

  • If you want an app, a live coach or lessons. It is self-guided and has none of these.
  • If you expect guided meditations. The two audio tracks are binaural beats, not spoken sessions.
  • If you need professional support. The seller says it isn’t therapy, diagnosis or medical advice, and it doesn’t replace a doctor or licensed professional.

Our honest take

We haven’t tried Calm Reset ourselves. This take is based on reading the seller’s page and listing what the bundle includes.

What stood out to us: the worked example and the fillable daily worksheet make it easier to begin, and it is a one-time purchase with no subscription.

What to keep in mind: only two files are fillable, the rest are printable PDFs, and the audio is binaural beats rather than guided meditation. Treat the claims as the seller’s own.

Good to know

  • The price on the seller’s page is $37, one time. Taxes, if any, show at checkout.
  • ClickBank is the retailer. The seller’s page says its checkout allows returns or exchanges within 60 days of purchase. Check ClickBank’s current refund policy before you buy.
  • For help opening the files, the seller’s page lists a support email for the product and download.
  • Results vary from person to person.
  • We’re an affiliate and may earn a commission if you buy through our link, at no extra cost to you.

A free bonus when you buy through us

Our printable 30-day Sleep & Rest Reset workbook is yours when you buy through the button on this page. Email your purchase receipt to the address in the bonus box, and we’ll send it after we confirm the purchase.

products.html:

How you might use it

  1. Download the ebook after you buy.
  2. Check the ingredient list and pantry guide, then pick one recipe to start with.
  3. The seller says most recipes take about 15–20 minutes of hands-on time.

Who it may suit

  • Vegans, or anyone avoiding eggs and dairy, who wants to bake at home.
  • Beginners who prefer clear, step-by-step recipes.

Who it may not suit

Our honest take

What to keep in mind: the page gives two different recipe counts, and it makes health and weight claims we can’t verify, so we don’t repeat them.

products.name: The Anxiety Reset Workbook: A 30-Day Guided Self-Help Plan
products.description: A printable 93-page, large-print self-help workbook with a 30-day plan, worked examples and reusable worksheets. Digital download, no shipping.
products.html:
A structured way to work through worry

Feeling caught in a cycle of worry can make it hard to know where to start. This workbook gives you a daily structure, a worked example for every activity, and plenty of room to write in your own words.

How the 30 days are organized

  • Week 1, Notice: recognize worry patterns and understand your thoughts.
  • Week 2, Calm: practice breathing, grounding and muscle-release exercises.
  • Week 3, Challenge: explore unhelpful thoughts and work through manageable fears.
  • Week 4, Reset: reflect on your progress and build habits you can keep.

How it works

  1. Set aside 10 to 15 minutes a day.
  2. Read the day’s short explanation and look at the worked example.
  3. Complete the guided exercise in your own words.
  4. Use the weekly check-ins to look back on your experience.

Preview the workbook

Who it may suit

  • Adults who want a structured, approachable way to reflect on worry and practice self-help exercises.
  • People who enjoy guided journaling and prefer practical worksheets to unstructured writing.
  • Readers who like large, easy-to-read text.

Who it may not suit

  • If you are looking for therapy or a diagnosis. This is an educational self-help resource.
  • If your anxiety is severe, lasts for weeks or interferes with daily life. Please talk with a qualified professional.
  • If you have chest pain, trouble breathing or a racing heart that has not been checked. See a doctor first.
  • It is not designed for trauma, and it does not replace treatment for panic disorder, OCD, depression or any other condition.

Important note

This workbook is not medical advice and does not diagnose or treat any condition. If you are in immediate danger or in crisis, contact local emergency services or a crisis line in your country. In the United States, call or text 988.

Before you decide

  • It is a digital download: one PDF, 93 pages, US Letter, 12 pt large print. Nothing is shipped.
  • It is sold through our shop at $12.99 on the page we linked. Check the current price there.
  • For personal use only. Please do not share or resell it.
details: 93-page printable PDF, US Letter size, large-print 12 pt text

A worked example for every day, guided prompts and roomy writing space

products.html:
Small habits for a calmer day

You don’t need a new life to feel better. This workbook is built around small, repeatable moments: a glass of water, a slow breath, a short walk, a quiet evening. It is designed to fit into busy mornings and tired evenings.

How the guide is organized

  • Morning Calm: a 10-minute morning reset, gentle stretching and a morning journal.
  • Calm Your Mind: breathing, grounding, mindful walking and a brain-dump page.
  • Nourish Your Body: a simple plate method, meal ideas and a weekly planner.
  • Move & Stretch: short stretches, desk breaks and a 7-day movement challenge.
  • Digital Wellness: phone boundaries, a declutter checklist and a screen-free evening.
  • Evening Calm: a 30-minute evening reset, a gratitude practice and sleep-friendly habits.

The 30-day plan

One small task a day, about 10 to 20 minutes, over four weeks: Reset, Nourish, Move & Unplug, and Rest & Reconnect. Missed a day? The guide says to skip it or do it later.

Preview the guide

How you might use it

  1. Start with the Wellness Wheel and set your 30-day intention.
  2. Follow the daily tasks in order, or pick the chapter you need most.
  3. Use the trackers and weekly planners to see what is worth keeping.
  4. At the end, reflect on your 30 days and design your own routine.

Who it may suit

  • People who want simple daily habits rather than a strict program.
  • Readers who enjoy filling in worksheets, checklists and trackers.
  • Anyone who wants a gentle, non-diet approach to eating, movement and rest.

Who it may not suit

  • If you need medical, dietary or mental health advice. The guide offers general wellness ideas only.
  • If you have an injury or health condition. Check with your doctor before starting a new activity.
  • If stress or low mood feels constant or overwhelming. Please reach out to a doctor or mental health professional.

Important note

This guide supports everyday wellness. It is not medical advice and does not diagnose or treat any condition. If you are in immediate danger or in crisis, contact local emergency services or a crisis line in your country. In the United States, call or text 988.

Before you decide

  • It is sold through our shop at $12.99 on the page we linked. Check the current price there.
  • For personal use only. Please do not share or resell it.
